scheduler_source_of_truth: live ChatGPT automation registry for this account
namespace_policy: Only this five-loop stack may write under automation_intelligence/omega_stack/. Other schedulers must use separate namespaces.
global_manifest_policy: Read-only contextual input. Do not use automation_intelligence/manifest.json as this stack's scheduler source of truth and do not overwrite unrelated scheduler topology fields.
persistence_policy: heartbeat.json is the only mutable IN_PROGRESS marker; pass 8 freezes RUN_CORE; pass 9 writes immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json and history/<RUN_ID>.json using GitHub-returned blob SHAs as content identity; pass 10 promotes latest.json and creates immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json binding current core/history/latest blob SHAs; only receipt-verified runs are fully persisted.

migration.v2_reason: Old agent branch diverged substantially from main; v2 starts from current main and carries only approved design/operational scaffolding.

persistence_bootstrap.rule: No substantive work before verified heartbeat persistence.
github_first_actions: fetch own heartbeat.json immediately before write
update heartbeat.json with current RUN_ID and IN_PROGRESS using that fresh content SHA
persistence_bootstrap.on_github_bootstrap_failure: Re-fetch heartbeat, reconcile, retry exactly once with fresh content SHA. If still unsuccessful, stop substantive work and attempt a Library failure receipt.
closure: Pass 8 freezes RUN_CORE only; do not compute or claim a model-generated cryptographic hash.

Pass 9 creates immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json containing exactly RUN_CORE; re-fetch and record GitHub run_core_blob_sha; then create immutable history/<RUN_ID>.json with HISTORY_VERIFIED, PASSES_COMPLETED=9, FINALIZATION_STATUS=AWAITING_LATEST_PROMOTION, core_path and run_core_blob_sha; re-fetch and record history_blob_sha.

Pass 10 writes latest.json with RUN_PERSISTED, PASSES_COMPLETED=10, core_path, run_core_blob_sha and history_blob_sha; re-fetch latest; create immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json binding the actual core/history/latest blob SHAs; re-fetch receipt; only then set heartbeat IDLE/FINALIZED.
